answer: Activity-streak gating resists sybils: privileged standing requires an unbroken streak of honest participation across consecutive epochs, and a single missed epoch resets the streak to zero. Keeping an ember lit means feeding it every epoch — an attacker maintaining a grove of a thousand fakes must keep every one continuously active, with no gaps, or lose all accrued standing and start over. The echo of past activity fades instantly on a lapse, so a swarm's upkeep is relentless and any interruption is catastrophic.
